answer: In PoA, every identity posts bonded collateral, while cryptographic evidence links conflicting votes or signatures. When k coordinated identities equivocate, their penalties scale quadratically, O(k^2), and detecting a sybil swarm applies an exponential multiplier to capital loss, compounded by asymmetric depreciation of escrows. This makes coordination prohibitively costly: pearl, zenith, and voyage can remain separate identities only through independently honest behavior.
